subject: Hosted API evaluation — scheduling & timezone check (Shopverse)
messages:
From: Aman Kumar <aman@shopverse.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API trial - quick eval request

Hi Connor,

I signed up for the Hosted API trial this morning and would love a short 30-min evaluation to walk through a couple of things: latency expectations at ~1k tokens, batch throughput, and how sandbox credentials work. I'll also loop in Priya (engineer) from my team.

We are PST-based; mornings Wed or Thu are best for us (before 11am PST). Do you have any available windows this week or early next? Also, is there any prework we should do so we can make the session hands-on?

Thanks,
Aman Kumar
Head of ML, Shopverse
aman@shopverse.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Aman Kumar <aman@shopverse.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API trial - quick eval request

Hi Aman — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Diego (our PLG field rep) is cc'd and will join the call to cover onboarding and sandbox provisioning. Quick answers up front: no heavy prework required — we can provision a short-lived API key and sample dataset during the session. Recording is fine if you want to share it internally.

Proposed 30-min windows (all PST):
- Wed Jul 16, 10:00–10:30am
- Wed Jul 16, 11:30–12:00pm
- Thu Jul 17, 09:00–09:30am

If none of those work, tell us a couple of options and we'll adapt. Agenda I suggest: 1) quick intro + goals (5 min), 2) sandbox/provisioning (10–12 min), 3) simple perf run and Q&A (12–15 min).

I'll hold the first slot tentatively. Attaching a brief checklist we typically share so you know what we'll cover.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
SDR, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-quickstart-checklist.pdf

From: Aman Kumar <aman@shopverse.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:18:00 -07:00

Thanks Connor — Wed 16 at 10:00am PST works better for us, but we have one conflict: Priya can't make 10:00 and asked if we can nudge to 10:30. Would 10:30–11:00 be possible?

Also few quick asks so we can prep:
- Can you provision an API key scoped to the sandbox during the call?
- Any bandwidth/throughput limits we should expect for the sandbox?
- We have a short list of security questions — I'm attaching our requirements sheet so Diego/Connor can flag anything that needs a pre-call note.

Attachment: shopverse-requirements.xlsx

If 10:30 is hard, we can do Thu 09:00.

Cheers,
Aman

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
Calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/meet/connor/20250715-10am

Looking forward,
